statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ (a b : ℕ) [NeZero a] [NeZero b], Nat.Coprime a b → ∃ e : {r : ℕ // r ∈ roots 1 (a*b)} ≃ ({u : ℕ // u ∈ roots 1 a} × {v : ℕ // v ∈ roots 1 b}), ∀ r, ((e r).1.val, (e r).2.val) = (r.val % a, r.val % b)
